data.title: Govt to host air mobility symposium
data.description: <p>Thailand will host the International Civil Aviation Organisation's (ICAO) Advanced Air Mobility Symposium in December, creating opportunities for investment, technology development and stronger global aviation cooperation.</p>

data.title: Julapun asks South Korea to ease curbs
data.description: <p>Thailand has asked South Korea to expand job opportunities for Thai workers and ease restrictions on seasonal workers amid concerns over labour shortages.</p>

data.title: Asia Era One seeks premature deal exit
data.description: <p>Asia Era One Co, a private-sector partner in the high-speed rail link project connecting three airports, has confirmed its request to terminate the contract and cancel its agreement to operate the Airport Rail Link, prompting the State Railway of Thailand (SRT) to seek an urgent solution, the Transport Ministry said.</p>

data.title: Govt urged to implement 'Line 43' in Thap Lan park
data.description: <p>The activist Thap Lan 43 Group is urging the government to resolve a long-running land dispute involving communities inside Thap Lan National Park by using "Line 43", a jointly surveyed boundary mapped out in 2000 to resolve overlapping claims.</p>

data.title: Kindergarten exams, rankings to end
data.description: <p>The Education Ministry has ordered schools nationwide to end competitive examinations and ranking systems for kindergarten students, citing the early childhood development law.</p>

data.title: PM mulls more arms for navy
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul yesterday inspected the Royal Thai Navy's combat readiness in the Gulf of Thailand and signalled the possible procurement of additional weapons and military equipment to replace ageing systems.</p>

data.title: Royal Irrigation Department steps up Chao Phraya monitoring as rain looms
data.description: <p>Royal Irrigation Department (RID) director-general Witthaya Kaewmee has ordered closer monitoring of water levels in the Chao Phraya River basin as more rain is forecast from Aug 29 to Sept 2.</p>

data.title: Siripong defends shift to EVs amid oil-cost concerns
data.description: <p>Deputy Transport Minister Siripong Angkasakulkiat has defended the government's plan to convert public-service vehicles to electric vehicles (EVs), saying the scheme could cut oil consumption by an estimated 212 million litres a year while reducing transport costs and dependence on imported fuel.</p>

data.title: Gold traders spared tax but more oversight urged
data.description: <p>The Finance Ministry has no immediate plan to tax gold trading but wants the Gold Traders Association to help strengthen oversight and prevent money laundering, a leading gold trader said.</p>

data.title: Speaker pressed over NACC panel
data.description: <p>The opposition has pressed House Speaker Sophon Zarum to disclose the names of an independent panel reviewing a request to investigate the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) over its dismissal of a complaint against former transport minister Saksayam Chidchob.</p>

data.title: The need for speed
data.description: <p>Revisiting the Speedmaster 38, Omega gravitated towards the legendary Moonwatch for the aesthetics of a new collection, released on Tuesday.</p>

data.title: It's cool, not fire
data.description: <p>There's something about Nordic crime dramas that intrigues me. Maybe it's the climate and atmosphere of those Scandinavian countries, where even the daylight can somehow feel cold and unsettling, especially when paired with slow-burn detective stories and methodical investigations.</p>

data.title: Full Statham ahead
data.description: <p>In modern action cinema, Jason Statham has become one of the most recogniseable faces of the genre. Unlike many other actors, he seems willing to take on just about any kind of action production, whether it is big or small-budget, successful or not.</p>

data.title: Iran executes over 500 people in 2026: rights group
data.description: PARIS — Iran has executed over 500 people so far this year after a new surge in hangings in recent days, despite United States President Donald Trump urging the Islamic republic to halt executions, a rights group said on Thursday.

data.title: Zambia opposition leader surrenders to police: state media
data.description: LUSAKA - The Zambian opposition leader who was runner-up in this month's disputed presidential election surrendered to police on Thursday after two weeks in hiding following a summons over an alleged national security threat, state media reported.

data.title: Srebrenica: Massacre that outraged the world
data.description: SARAJEVO - Srebrenica became a symbol of ethnic cleansing after its men and boys were massacred by Bosnian Serbs following a three-year-long siege during the Balkan wars of the 1990s.

data.title: Alleged 9/11 mastermind to go on trial in June 2028
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, the alleged mastermind of the September 11, 2001 attacks on the United States, will go on trial before a US military court in June 2028, an official said Thursday.

data.title: After US settlement, EU says Meta must 'protect our kids too'
data.description: BRUSSELS (BELGIUM) - The EU said Thursday it expects Meta to address "addictive" features of its platforms in Europe, after the tech giant agreed to sweeping limits on teen use of Facebook and Instagram in some US states.

data.title: 'Butcher of Bosnia' Ratko Mladic dead: Serbian state media
data.description: THE HAGUE - ⁠Ratko Mladic, the former Bosnian Serb military chief dubbed the "Butcher of Bosnia" for his role in the 1995 Srebrenica massacre, has died, Serbian state broadcaster RTS reported on Thursday.

data.title: Experts urge Thailand to derive more value from rising investment
data.description: Experts at KT Dialogue urge Thailand to turn rising investment into stronger local supply chains, technology transfer and high-value manufacturing.

data.title: Explosives used to rob gold store near Thai-Cambodian border
data.description: Sa Kaeo: Police launched a hunt on Thursday for a robber who used explosives to make off with gold goods from a shop in a Lotus's superstore located in tambon Banmai Nongsai of Aranya Prathet district.

data.title: Iran, Qatar hold Hormuz talks as US blockade chokes Iran oil imports
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran's top diplomat met his Qatari counterpart on Thursday in Tehran for talks on the strategic Strait of Hormuz, as a US naval blockade squeezes oil supplies to Iran amid a domestic shortfall.

data.title: BOI pushes high-tech investment deeper into Thai supply chains
data.description: Thailand’s BOI reports a 27% rise in realised investment and is targeting high-tech industries to deepen domestic supply chains and skills.

data.title: Swallowed by silt: Survivors recount Nepal flood horror
data.description: BIDUR (NEPAL) - Survivors from Nepal's flood-ravaged districts, some on stretchers, others supported by the shoulders, being airlifted to safety on Thursday from the town of Bidur, spoke of the devastation that hit their community.

data.title: More sparks fly over Senate collusion case
data.description: The controversy over the Election Commission’s investigation into alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election intensified on Thursday, with senators accusing opposition figures of pressuring the poll agency and prejudging the case.

data.title: No Thais reported hurt in Nepal landslides
data.description: There are no reports of Thai nationals being injured, killed or missing following devastating flash floods and landslides in Nepal, according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

data.title: Devastation of Pakistan infant ward fire revealed
data.description: ISLAMABAD - Twisted ceiling frames, charred walls and a shaft of sunlight piercing a partially collapsed roof were all that was left of a neonatal ward on Thursday after a devastating hospital fire killed 14 infants in Pakistan.

data.title: Germany reports record 15,800 heat-related deaths
data.description: BERLIN - Germany has registered a record 15,800 heat-related deaths this summer as Europe struggles through a series of punishing heatwaves, the national public health institute said Thursday.

data.title: Book Early, Stay Better at Courtyard by Marriott Bangkok
data.description: Bangkok, August 2026 – Planning ahead comes with more ways to enjoy your stay. With the “Book Early, Stay Better” offer at Courtyard by Marriott Bangkok, guests who book at least 30 days in advance can enjoy enhanced comfort, added flexibility and extra value throughout their stay.

data.title: Ex-Pheu Thai candidate held in exam fraud case
data.description: A former Pheu Thai Party candidate has been arrested in Bangkok for allegedly soliciting money in exchange for helping candidates pass civil service exams in his home province of Si Sa Ket.

data.title: Chicken Oreo? Only in China … for now
data.description: The worlds of sweet and savoury have collided again. This time, KFC and Oreo are putting their unlikely partnership between two buns.

data.title: Activists stand up to fellow Jews to protect Palestinians
data.description: JANNATAH, Palestinian Territories - Ziva Sharp said her Jewish faith motivated her to travel from Jerusalem to the West Bank to stand up for Palestinians — a commitment that led to her being set upon by fellow Israelis also professing to be driven by Judaism.

data.title: Taiwan approves $7.6bn drone budget as China threat grows
data.description: TAIPEI - Lawmakers in Taiwan approved a US$7.6-billion budget for locally made drones on Thursday as the island democracy seeks to strengthen its defences against a potential Chinese attack.

data.title: Norway’s King Harald in ‘extremely serious’ condition
data.description: OSLO - The health of Norway’s 89-year-old King Harald, hospitalised with a blood disease, has deteriorated and he is in an “extremely serious” condition, the palace said Thursday.

data.title: STA Drives Growth with Highest Q2 Profit in 4 Years, Advances "Empowering AI" Mission
data.description: Sri Trang Agro-Industry Public Company Limited (STA), The world’s largest fully integrated natural rubber enterprise and Thailand’s leading rubber glove manufacture, reported a revenue of THB 31,003.8 million in Q2/2026, up 15.5%, and a net profit of THB 895 million, the highest in 4 years, representing 38.7% increase QoQ. For 6M/2026, the Company recorded revenue of THB 57,845.6 million, with a net profit of THB 1,540.4 million, returning to profit compared with the same period last year. This strong performance was supported by improved profitability across both its natural rubber and rubber glove businesses.

data.title: MoMo Café launch a new menu where global favorites meet truly thai classics
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand – August 2026 – Courtyard by Marriott Bangkok introduces a new culinary chapter atMoMoCaféwith the launch of a refreshed all-day dining menu where Global Favorites meet Truly Thai Classics . Led by newly appointed Executive Chef Jack,UkritSangprapai , the new menu reflects evolving guest preferences through quality ingredients, authentic recipes, and familiar flavors designed to bring people together.

data.title: How Roblox revitalised an 82-year-old grandma
data.description: Picture this: an 82-year-old grandmother, viral on Tiktok, playing Roblox. Maybe you can’t, but you should.

data.title: Medical Fair Asia 2026 brings Asia’s healthcare ecosystem together in Singapore
data.description: More than 1,000 exhibitors from 40 countries and regions will gather at Marina Bay Sands as Medical Fair Asia, Medical Manufacturing Asia and the inaugural RehaCare Asia connect medical innovation, manufacturing, healthcare delivery and rehabilitation in one regional platform.

data.title: Army says 52 drug smugglers killed in North in past 10 months
data.description: Thai soldiers have killed 52 drug smugglers in northern border areas since Oct 1 last year, according to the commander of the Pha Muang Task Force.
